faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What is modern interior design?

It uses clean lines, open layouts, a calm colour palette and furniture with simple forms. The focus is on light, space and practical storage rather than heavy decoration.

Can a farmhouse in Chhattarpur have a modern interior?

Yes. A farmhouse can mix modern furniture and lighting with natural stone, wood and large windows, so it feels current while staying connected to the outdoors.

Is modern interior design easy to maintain?

Usually yes. Fewer mouldings, flat surfaces and concealed storage make cleaning easier. We also choose finishes that suit Delhi's dust and heat.

Do you use modern design for offices as well?

Yes. Offices, salons and showrooms also benefit from simple layouts, good lighting and durable modern finishes.
